informationCategory.comment: An information category this instance added. WooCategoryRegistry reads it, and refuses one that names no waardelijst member

informationCategory.title: Information category
informationCategory.summary: An information category this instance added itself
informationCategory.description: The 18 information categories of the Woo come from the scw_woo_informatiecategorieen waardelijst and need no row here. A row adds a category of your own, with its own sitemap and its own schemas. It must say which waardelijst member it publishes under, because the national index accepts no other value. A row that does not is refused: it gets no sitemap, so nothing it holds is offered to the index.

code.title: Code
code.description: The code a publication stores and the sitemap file name carries. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 48 characters. Pick one that is not an infocat code, because those are taken.

title.title: Name
title.description: The Dutch name of the category, as readers see it.

titleEn.title: Name in English
titleEn.description: The English name. Left empty, the Dutch name is used.

mapsTo.title: Publishes under
mapsTo.description: The waardelijst member this category is offered to the national index as. Give an infocat code, the official name, or the TOOI identifier. A value that is not a member means the category publishes nothing.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: The schemas this category's sitemap lists, by slug. Left empty, every schema of the catalogue is listed, which is what the 18 bundled categories do.

soortHandeling.title: Document handling
soortHandeling.description: What happened to the document on the publication date. The national index takes one of three values from the DiWoo documenthandelingen list. Left empty, receipt is used.
